meta.scope_note: Broad lightweight synthetic population, six rich cases, representative lifecycle records, and a separate frozen comparison. Integrity-review work must be counted separately from additive opportunities.
meta.contact_note: All names and records are fictional; .example contact addresses cannot receive real messages.

members.name: Jordan Ellis
members.summary: The signed current encounter explicitly documents chronic systolic heart failure. The selected coded dataset has no corresponding diagnosis. Review the source passage before a supported coding decision.

members.name: Morgan Reed
members.summary: COPD appears in a 2025 encounter, but available current-period records contain no assessment. A visit is scheduled for September 18. A neutral pre-visit task can request a current assessment.

members.name: Avery Brooks
members.summary: Repeated laboratory and pharmacy context suggests a kidney-related assessment need. No current clinician diagnosis is documented. The signal can create an assessment task, but cannot approve a diagnosis.

members.name: Taylor Quinn
members.condition: Existing heart failure diagnosis · integrity review
members.summary: The reviewed source contradicts the existing submitted heart failure condition. The original submission remains retained. A correction received transport acknowledgement, then a terminal rejection; resolution is still pending.

members.name: Casey Morgan
members.summary: The encounter documents diabetes and chronic kidney disease. Compare the combined full-member scenario after a reviewed model pack is configured. No official code mapping, coefficient, or score is installed in this demo.

members.name: Riley Parker
members.summary: COPD is explicitly documented, but the source has no clinician signature metadata. The selected demo source policy blocks preparation until a signed encounter source is supplied. Route a remediation task.

sections.text: Jordan Ellis · MB-000001 · Service date 2026-08-28. This is a fictional record for demonstration.

sections.heading: Reason for visit
sections.text: Scheduled follow-up for chronic cardiovascular conditions. Symptoms and ongoing management were reviewed at today's encounter.

sections.heading: Assessment and plan
sections.text: Chronic systolic heart failure is present and was assessed today. The member is clinically stable. Continue the established management plan and monitor symptoms at follow-up.

sections.heading: Documentation context
sections.text: The diagnosis is stated as current by the treating clinician. It is not family history, a rule-out diagnosis, or a historical-only mention. The selected coded dataset does not contain the corresponding diagnosis.

sections.heading: Signature
sections.text: Electronically signed by the synthetic treating clinician at Northbrook Family Care on August 28, 2026.

sections.heading: Use in current review

sections.heading: Next review step
sections.text: This new signed source must undergo a new coding review. A pre-visit response or completion of a task does not itself approve the diagnosis.

sections.text: Avery Brooks · MB-000003 · Service date 2026-08-21. This is a fictional record for demonstration.

sections.heading: Available observations
sections.text: Repeated laboratory results include reduced estimated kidney filtration values. The pharmacy context contains therapies that may warrant a medication and kidney-function review.

sections.heading: Clinician assessment
sections.text: No current clinician diagnosis of chronic kidney disease is documented in the available record. Laboratory and pharmacy context alone does not establish a diagnosis.

sections.heading: Neutral assessment request
sections.text: Please review the available kidney-function results and medication context, assess their clinical significance, and document your findings as appropriate. No diagnosis is presumed.

sections.text: Taylor Quinn · MB-000004 · Service date 2026-08-19. This is a fictional record for demonstration.

sections.heading: Existing submitted record
sections.text: A heart failure condition is present in an earlier submitted record. The original outbound record and its receiver history remain retained for reconciliation.

sections.heading: Current clinician assessment
sections.text: There is no evidence of heart failure in the reviewed encounter. The prior heart failure entry is not supported by this source and should not be carried forward from this note.

sections.heading: Integrity workflow
sections.text: An independent QA review is required for the proposed correction. A transport acknowledgement confirms receipt only. The prepared correction was later rejected because the original receiver reference did not match; the correction remains unresolved.

comparison.method: Authored synthetic fixture illustrating a stratified randomized comparison with two disjoint 100-chart arms. Each chart has ten prespecified condition-evaluation slots. Independent reference labels are frozen and are never derived from presenter actions.
comparison.limitations: This is not an actual experiment, clinical validation, customer outcome, or causal effect estimate. It is separate from the 10,000-member operational population. A slot is a chart-condition evaluation unit, not a member or an approved diagnosis.
